blocks.text: AI is fun and useful, but on the internet the safety rules always apply.
Important: Claude is for adults (18+). So practise the Claude lessons together with a parent, who uses their own account.
Important: you may use ChatGPT from age 13 and only with a parent's permission. If you're younger, practise together with a parent.
Important: you need a parent's permission for Gemini. Younger children can use it only through a parent's Family Link account, where available.

items: Your full name, address or school.
Photos of faces – yours or anyone else's.

blocks.text: If an AI (or anyone online) writes something that scares you, confuses you or makes you uncomfortable – stop and tell a parent or teacher straight away. It's not your fault and you won't be in trouble.
AI can make pictures and voices that look real but aren't. Don't believe everything you see online right away.
Golden rule: if you wouldn't say it to a stranger on the street, don't write it to an AI.
Give me 5 rules for using the internet safely, for 12-year-olds, short and clear.
